newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indonesia Bank BII HK unit loan raised.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Bank BII HK unit loan raised.

text.p: Hongkong-based BII Finance Co Ltd's transferable loan facility has been increased to US$35 million from US$30 million due to oversubscription, the arrangers said.
The facility is secured by a letter of comfort from PT Bank Internasional Indonesia.
The three-year loan has a put option on the second anniversary. It pays a margin of 150 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 175 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers, with US$5 million each, are KMBC Asia and Standard Chartered Bank.
Co-lead managers are GE Capital Finance and Hana Finance Asia, with US$4.5 million each, and Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp, with US$4 million.

Senior managers are Banque Nationale de Paris's Singapore branch and First Merchant Banking Corp, with US$3 million each, and Banca di Roma's Hongkong branch, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz and Staal Bankiers, with US$2 million each.
Signing is set for June 12 in Hong Kong.
